# Code of Conduct

GFI welcomes contributors of every experience level. Be respectful, assume
good intent, and keep discussions focused on improving the project.

Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, and publishing private
information are not acceptable. Report a safety or conduct concern privately
to the maintainers listed in the repository documentation rather than opening
a public issue.

Maintainers may remove comments, close discussions, or restrict participation
when needed to keep the project safe and constructive.
